note: Accepted visual values per environment, written only by node scripts/visual-gate.mjs --update-baseline. Percentages are pixels that differ from tests/visual/reference.png (pixelmatch threshold 0.12), whose sha256 each environment stores as reference. A re-acceptance may raise a region's mismatch by at most its stored runToRunPct + 2 pp; acceptedRises records each rise accepted beyond that, and each regeneration of the reference, with --accept-rise and its reason. See scripts/visual-gate.mjs.
